answer: A grove of agents can resist sybils with time-locked stake bonds: each agent locks collateral for weeks before its votes count, and reputation accrues slowly like a lotus opening, then decays without verified work. A fake identity cannot buy instant standing; it must park capital and perform real tasks, so an attacker spawning a thousand clones pays a thousand lockups plus the opportunity cost of idle funds, while honest agents pass like a zephyr because their history already proves them.
